rows.notes: The study is a narrative review/position paper on sustainable water management with no own experiment, survey or model run. The passage reproduces the list of localized-irrigation improvements from section 3.1 and section 4, which are recommendations without supporting data. Table 1 (kiwi under drip vs micro-sprinkler vs overhead sprinkler) is reproduced from the authors' earlier publication (Chartzoulakis et al., 1991), i.e. cited prior work, not this study's own result, and it compares irrigation systems rather than the listed improvements.

Same study: narrative review with no primary data. The productivity statements for localized irrigation rest on cited work (Postel et al., 2001 for 20-90% yield increases; Chartzoulakis et al., 1991 for Table 1, where kiwi yields did not differ significantly between systems). None of the listed improvements (single drip line, micro-sprayers, pressure control, filters, automation) is tested in this paper.

The study is a review/recommendation paper. The statement on volumetric metering, progressive and block tariffs and drought surcharges contributing to water savings appears in section 4 (Recommendations for Best Irrigation Practices) as a policy recommendation with no data, case study or analysis of metering effects on water use.
